question: What Speed Limit (R2-1) sign sizes are shown in Table 2B-1 for conventional single-lane, conventional multi-lane, expressway, and freeway applications?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Table 2B-1 (Regulatory Sign and Plaque Sizes, Sheet 1 of 6) lists the Speed Limit (R2-1) sign, referenced to Section 2B.21, with the following sizes (width x height, in inches): 24 x 30 for single-lane conventional roads, 30 x 36 for multi-lane conventional roads, 36 x 48 for expressways, and 48 x 60 for freeways. The table also shows a Minimum size of 18 x 24 and an Oversized size of 30 x 36, with a table note that larger signs may be used when appropriate. Visual evidence: - [Image 5] Page 109 shows Table 2B-1 (Sheet 1 of 6), where the "Speed Limit / R2-1 / 2B.21" row reads: Single Lane 24 x 30, Multi-Lane 30 x 36, Expressway 36 x 48, Freeway 48 x 60, Minimum 18 x 24, Oversized 30 x 36, with the note that dimensions are shown in inches as width x height. - [Image 1] Figure 2B-3 illustrates the Speed Limit (R2-1) sign design and its related plaques (R2-2P, R2-3P, R2-4P, etc.) referenced by the size table. Citations: - Page 109 - Figure 2B-3 (p.86)
gold_answer: 24 x 30, 30 x 36, 36 x 48, and 48 x 60 inches, respectively.
